{{Top}}
A '''dart gun'''<ref name="Traitor">{{DarkStryder|adventure=Traitor in our Midst|book=The DarkStryder Campaign}}</ref> or '''dart pistol'''<ref name="Elrood">[[Operation: Elrood (book)|''Operation: Elrood'']]</ref> was a projectile weapon that fired [[Dart/Legends|darts]]. In [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]], [[the Wraith]] used a miniature dart gun loaded with [[Poison/Legends|poison]]-tipped darts in an effort to [[Assassin/Legends|assassinate]] [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Kaiya Adrimetrum]], [[Commanding officer/Legends|commanding officer]] of the ''[[FarStar]]''.<ref name="Traitor" />
